notes: 'The only river Budapest lies on' is a firm Func(on_river) (the question's presupposition; on_river is many-valued in RELATIONS.md). q0 asks whether the river Budapest lies on flows through Basel; q1 uses drains_into for 'flows into the sea'. q2: pre 'no' follows because Cologne lies on the Rhine and a city lies on one river, so the Danube does not flow through Cologne (q0 is the same with Basel). related[0]: the Chain Bridge stands in Budapest (firm), so the river it crosses is the river Budapest lies on (stands_in then on_river): the Danube before, the Rhine after (a city lies on one river).
